guides.title: Sensitive group membership triage
steps: Identify who or what made the change, and through which process.
Check for an access request and who approved it.
Check the target's role against the group's membership policy.
A change made through the approved workflow, approved by the manager, matching the target's role, is benign.
Escalate as true positive if the change bypassed the workflow or was not approved.
